summary: Ion Storm Dallas's science-fiction RPG built on a heavily modified Quake II engine, remembered for its comic noir tone and turn-based party combat.

entries.title: Anachronox
entries.definitive_edition: No official remaster; use the modern Windows PC release with compatibility fixes as needed

emulation.notes: No emulation needed, but modern Windows fixes may be required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC visuals, optionally improved with community display fixes.

primary.version: Modern Windows PC release via GOG or Steam
primary.why: Anachronox is a Windows-only RPG; modern PC storefront releases are the complete and highest-fidelity route, with community fixes available for current systems.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release from GOG or Steam, then follow compatibility guidance for widescreen, sound, and modern Windows stability.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows release built on a modified Quake II engine; modern storefront versions remain PC-only.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform and complete play route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented release platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or sequel completion; the shipped game is the complete released product, but the planned continuation was never made.
